Script.name: MSDP Protocol
Script.script:
-- All MSDP variables the GUI subscribes to. GUI.MSDP_REPORT_VARS = { "CHARACTER_NAME", "RACE", "CLASS", "ALIGNMENT", "LEVEL", "STR", "DEX", "CON", "INT", "WIS", "CHA", "AC", "MONEY", "HEALTH", "HEALTH_MAX", "OPPONENT_HEALTH", "OPPONENT_HEALTH_MAX", "OPPONENT_NAME", "MOVEMENT", "MOVEMENT_MAX", "PSP", "PSP_MAX", "EXPERIENCE", "EXPERIENCE_TNL", "ACTIONS", "GROUP", "AFFECTS", -- "INVENTORY", "ROOM", "AREA_NAME", "ROOM_EXITS", "ROOM_NAME", "ROOM_VNUM", "WORLD_TIME", }
-- Subscribe to every MSDP variable the GUI needs. -- Safe to call more than once; re-REPORTing an already-reported variable -- simply refreshes it. Needed after resetProfile(), where sysProtocolEnabled -- does NOT fire again because MSDP was already negotiated on the connection. function GUI.requestMSDPReports() -- Releases before the focused source split registered profile-reset -- lifecycle closures without retaining their IDs. During an in-session -- package upgrade Mudlet can keep that legacy closure alive, causing the -- old and new reset callbacks to request the same REPORT set together. -- Coalesce that migration overlap without changing later explicit calls. if GUI.msdpReportRequestPending then GUI.debug("MSDP/REPORT", "duplicate subscription request coalesced") return true end GUI.msdpReportRequestPending = true if type(tempTimer) == "function" then tempTimer(0.5, function() GUI.msdpReportRequestPending = false end) else GUI.msdpReportRequestPending = false end
GUI.debug("MSDP/REPORT", "subscription request started", { sendMSDP = type(sendMSDP), variableCount = #GUI.MSDP_REPORT_VARS, }) if not sendMSDP then GUI.debugError("MSDP/REPORT", "sendMSDP is unavailable") return false end for _, var in ipairs(GUI.MSDP_REPORT_VARS) do GUI.debug("MSDP/REPORT", "sending REPORT", var) local ok, result = GUI.debugCall( "MSDP/REPORT/" .. var, sendMSDP, "REPORT", var ) if not ok then GUI.debug("MSDP/REPORT", "REPORT failed", { variable = var, error = result, }) end end GUI.debug("MSDP/REPORT", "subscription request complete") return true end
function GUI.onProtocolEnabled(_, protocol) GUI.debug("MSDP/PROTOCOL", "sysProtocolEnabled received", { protocol = protocol, enableMSDP = type(getConfig) == "function" and getConfig("enableMSDP") or "unavailable", }) if protocol == "MSDP" then print("[GUI] MSDP Protocol enabled - initializing variables")
GUI.requestMSDPReports()
-- Debug: Show what variables are available after a short delay tempTimer(2, GUI.debugWrap("MSDP/PROTOCOL/two-second inventory", function() GUI.debug("MSDP/PROTOCOL", "MSDP variables received") local count = 0 for k, v in pairs(msdp) do if type(v) ~= "function" then count = count + 1 GUI.debug("MSDP/VALUE", "msdp." .. tostring(k), v) end end GUI.debug("MSDP/PROTOCOL", "MSDP variable inventory complete", { count = count, }) if type(GUI.debugSnapshot) == "function" then GUI.debugCall( "SNAPSHOT/MSDP protocol", GUI.debugSnapshot, "two seconds after MSDP protocol enabled" ) end end))
-- Initialize or refresh GUI after a short delay to ensure MSDP data arrives tempTimer(0.5, GUI.debugWrap("MSDP/PROTOCOL/GUI refresh", function() GUI.initializeOrRefresh("MSDP protocol enabled") end)) end end
